BIG BREAKING: The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) has confirmed two cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in Karnataka, India. 

According to the ICMR, two HMPV cases were reported at Baptist Hospital, Bengaluru: a 3-month-old girl and an 8-month-old boy. https://t.co/uvzDr1N57a
